title: Interpreter
summary: INTER'PRETER, noun One that explains or expounds; an expositor; as an interpreter of the Scriptures. 1. A translator; one who renders the words of one language in words of corresponding signification

inlines.v: INTER'PRETER, noun One that explains or expounds; an expositor; as an interpreter of the Scriptures. 1. A translator; one who renders the words of one language in words of corresponding signification in another.
